result: We ran the slides-first planner on board types it never practiced on. Larger boards (32x32): 174 of 175 standard puzzles, and 17 solutions got shorter while none got longer. Larger boards, hard exam: 251 of 275 solved — a program record — vs 239 for the standard search, with 77 solutions shorter and 3 longer. Crowded boards (8 robots): 23 shorter and none longer, plus the biggest cut in wasted moves of any size. Crowded boards, hard exam: 276 of 289 solved, with 82 of 84 differing solutions shorter.
conclusion: The fix is a property of the method, not of one board size. It worked everywhere, with no extra training. On the hardest large-board exam it set a program record for puzzles solved and still used fewer moves.
